# Name: # The flight computer's partition table for a board whose boot flash is 4 MB:
# in the package. Selected by sdkconfig.defaults.flash4mb
# declaration that goes with it. Every other board keeps partitions.csv.
# slots cut from 3 MB to 1.9375 MB each (0x1F0000): the largest pair on the
# 64 KB app alignment that fits after nvs and otadata. An image that outgrows a
# slot fails the build ("All app partitions are too small for binary")
# OTA of one is refused by esp_ota_begin before anything is erased.
# `nvs` and `otadata` keep the offsets and sizes they have in partitions.csv
# so the tools and notes that name them hold for both tables.

Type: 64 KB short of the end of the part.
